All three deliverables are in place and the full mechanical oracle chain is green. Summary of what I did and why, since this run had already failed 3 times at `s10a-oracle-code`:

**What existed already** (from a prior attempt in this run): `games/p5_gridnav/core/patrol.gd` (BFS `next_step`/`path_length` on `Array[Array[bool]]`) and `games/p5_gridnav/tests/run_tests.gd` (13 assertions). These were correct and untouched by me.

**Root cause of the repeated failure**: `scripts/forge/godot_oracle.mjs` unconditionally requires `res://solvability.gd` at the project root (hardcoded `SOLVABILITY_SCRIPT`), regardless of any `is_game` flag in the run's `state.json`. Attempt 3 had reasoned this project was a pure library module (not a game) and declined to add it, reporting the gap as out-of-ownership infra — but the oracle still ran and returned `BLOCKED`/exit 1, which is why the escalation kept recurring. I added `games/p5_gridnav/solvability.gd`, staying strictly inside `games/p5_gridnav/`: a deterministic bot using `Patrol.next_step` to cross a seeded 16×16 grid, with the maze carved **unconditionally** from the seed alone (never consulting `Patrol.path_length`, to avoid the tautology bug this codebase already hit once in `grid_nav_probe`).

**Verification**: `node scripts/forge/godot_oracle.mjs games/p5_gridnav` → `run_tests.gd`: 13 passed/0 failed. `solvability_godot.mjs` (R9, 50 trials): 50 won/0 lost, `verdict: OK`.
